# Consolas

Consolas is a dark monospaced theme that uses a TrueType font inspired by Visual Studio Code. It supports font ligatures, yellow-and-purple accents, gradual header shading and minimal-style checkboxes, and states compatibility with Git, Calendar, Quiet Outline and Kanban.

![Consolas screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinei/obsidian-consolas-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

}
